name: Beursschouwburg
funding: Flemish Community, Flemish Community Commission (VGC); non-profit multidisciplinary cultural house.

name: Kunstfort bij Vijfhuizen
funding: Mondriaan Fund, Municipality of Haarlemmermeer, Province of North Holland; registered ANBI cultural foundation.
watch: UNESCO military fortress converted into a center for contemporary art, speculative ecological research, and science fiction.

name: Netwerk Aalst
funding: Flemish Government Cultural Department, City of Aalst; independent non-profit arts institution.
watch: Independent center for contemporary art, artist cinema, and slow research; non-extractive labor practices.

name: Kunstraum Kreuzberg/Bethanien
records_note: Bethanien names its partners and funders on one undated page but posts no annual reports, accounts or board; its team page names two directors.

name: SAVVY Contemporary: The Laboratory of Form-Ideas
funding: Senate Department for Culture and Social Cohesion Berlin, Kulturstiftung des Bundes; independent non-profit cultural initiative.

name: daadgalerie
watch: Public exhibition space of the world's premier international artists' fellowship program (Berliner Künstlerprogramm).

name: Kunstverein in Hamburg
funding: Ministry of Culture and Media of the Free and Hanseatic City of Hamburg, Member Dues; registered non-profit art association.
watch: Founded in 1817; among the oldest German kunstvereins, consistently curating urgent social and political interventions.

name: Shedhalle (Rote Fabrik)
funding: City of Zurich Culture Department, Canton of Zurich, Pro Helvetia; autonomous cultural association.

name: Neuer Berliner Kunstverein (n.b.k.)
funding: Senate Department for Culture and Social Cohesion of Berlin, Stiftung Deutsche Klassenlotterie; non-profit art association.
watch: Houses one of Europe's oldest public video art collections (Video-Forum) and an Artothek lending library for citizens.

name: Kölnischer Kunstverein
funding: City of Cologne Department of Art and Culture, Kunststiftung NRW; member-supported non-profit association.

name: Portikus
funding: City of Frankfurt culture office (permanent), Hessian science and arts ministry for 2022 to 2026, Stiftung Giersch (2006 building), Städelschule Portikus e.V., cooperation partner THE FLAG since 2025.
watch: Part of the Städelschule art academy. The first text's Helaba and Wüstenrot Stiftung are not on the page. No protest or censorship found.
records_note: No annual report, accounts or board; the about page names the City of Frankfurt, the Hessian ministry (2022 to 2026), Stiftung Giersch and THE FLAG.

name: Bétonsalon – Centre d'art et de recherche
funding: City of Paris, DRAC Île-de-France (French Ministry of Culture), Université Paris Cité; certified clean public trust.
